comparison.objective: Read a six-note card and strike the correct bars in time using one mallet in each hand.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual rhythmic striking, timing, target selection, and mallet rebound; it does not stabilize a coaxial mandrel or recover fractured material.
comparison.success_condition: Correct six-note sequence at half-second intervals with alternating arm groups; wrong or late notes are irreversible. Exact timing windows, impact thresholds, release, damage, and final-state criteria are missing.
comparison.reason: This is the closest record for controlled impacts, but it tests timed dual-mallet percussion; the candidate tests asymmetric stabilization/hammering, physical notch fracture, insert protection, and exhaustive fragment recovery.
